title: Nationality, Race, and Ethnicity Biases in and Consequences of Detecting AI-Generated Self-Presentations
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It investigates how source cues (race, ethnicity, nationality) and content heuristics affect human judgments of AI-generated content in the context of college applications.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on biases related to race, ethnicity, and nationality. The only mention of a religious group (Jews) is as a brief, illustrative example from prior literature on stereotype content models, not as a component of the study's experiment or results.
